goal: Allow running txindex on pruned nodes so operators can find historical transactions without the full chain
Let RPC and REST callers distinguish pruned transactions from missing ones to fetch missing blocks on demand
reviewability: Author addressed recent review requests by updating RPC docs and adding release notes
agreement: Strong concept support for running a full transaction index on pruned nodes (ajtowns, arejula27, optout21)
Open suggestion to report pruned block hash in gettxoutproof when tx has unspent outputs (arejula27)
Open question whether TxIndexMissErrorDetails synced check can be hit given f_txindex_ready (fjahr)

categories.name: indexes
why: P2 because it resolves four long-standing requests since 2017 for txindex support on pruned nodes
Pruned node operators can locate historical transactions without storing the entire blockchain

categories.name: rpc
why: P3 because it lets RPC and REST endpoints return candidate block hashes for pruned transactions
Callers can identify missing blocks to retrieve them on demand via getblockfrompeer and retry lookups
